[[File:SlabinMolecule-Corruption.png|thumb|right|200px|Slabin's [[:Wikipedia:Molecule|molecular structure]]]]
{{Quote|If we add it we can make twice as much tea at twice the profit.|[[Tee Va/Legends|Tee Va]]|<ref name="CO">{{TCW|Corruption (episode)}}</ref>}}
'''Slabin''' was a dilutant used to increase the volume of an otherwise pure substance.<ref name="EpGuide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode305.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Corruption}}</ref> Normally non-[[Poison/Legends|toxic]], slabin could become harmful if an improper concentration was ingested, leading to severe illness. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], several [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] children on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] suffered the ill effects of a slabin overdosing after drinking slabin-laced [[Tea/Legends|tea]] that had been illegally imported by [[Moogan/Legends|Moogan]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]]. Their case would prove non-lethal, however, when New Mandalorian leader [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] was able to obtain a viable antidote.

==History==
[[File:Slabin-Corruption.png|thumb|left|200px|Slabin being mixed with [[Ardees Beverage/Legends|Ardees Beverage tea]]]]
{{Quote|Isn't it toxic?''"<br />"''Only if the dosage is wrong, so get your mixture right.|[[Unidentified Mandalorian male]] and [[Tee Va/Legends|Tee Va]]|<ref name="CO" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], [[Moogan/Legends|Moogan]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] transported containers of [[Ardees Beverage/Legends|tea]] from the [[Ardees Beverage Company/Legends|Ardees Beverage Company]] to the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]], on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. Desiring an increase in their [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|profits]], the smugglers and their [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Tee Va/Legends|Tee Va]], added slabin to the illegally imported [[Tea/Legends|tea]], diluting it. However, because the slabin concentration was incorrect, it made the tea a debilitating [[Poison/Legends|toxin]] for any unknowing consumer. The bottles were distributed among the Sundari's [[Sundari Mandalorian school/Legends|school]] children and as a result, several hundred became sick from ingesting the contaminated beverage and had to be [[Sundari Mandalorian hospital/Legends|hospitalized]].<ref name="CO" /> Thankfully for the children, New Mandalorian [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] [[Zak Zaz/Legends|Zak Zaz]] was able to correct diagnose the source of their illness, and the leader of the New Mandalorians, [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]], managed to secure an antidote.<ref name="CO" />
